items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The problem is with George Coleman, I think, because of the little hip drummer.

ctx.x: He tried Sonny Stitt. He tried Hank Mobley. He went through a lot of cats. Sam Rivers was one of the guys that he went through. George Coleman.
The problem is with George Coleman, I think, because of the little hip drummer.
Tony Williams. He didn’t get along with George?
